# Contour — Real Estate Operations & Field Agent OS
> Built for Southern African Real Estate Brokerages & Property Managers.

## Machine Interface Contract:
- **Protocol**: JSON-RPC 2.0 (Model Context Protocol)
- **Endpoint**: POST https://contour.app/api/mcp
- **Authentication**: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>

## Available AI Tools:
1. `search_properties`: Query active inventory across Kabulonga, Leopards Hill, Woodlands, Roma Park with GPS landmark navigation.
2. `get_rental_arrears`: Retrieve overdue tenancies with calculated days past due.
3. `generate_landlord_statement`: Reconcile monthly rent collected less 10% agency fee and maintenance.
